status: frozen research-only preflight before scanning; no runtime implementation or match
hypothesis: Prepare two Miners against different publicly known Bomb entries beside one possible Flag. First defuse forces removal of that Miner; the defender displaced to the first entry may no longer stop the second entry. This differs from clearing a defender with an escort or selecting one lead Miner.
public_gate: Target is a disclosed enemy Flag or an unmoved undisclosed enemy token, with at least two adjacent disclosed enemy Bombs. Pair distinct own Miners to distinct Bomb entries. Routes contain only empty transit squares and known Bomb endpoint, with exact current first-edge shuttle.
diagnostic_levels: Ready means both Miners have immediate legal Bomb captures; near means both assigned distances are at most2 or3 actions. These are fixed geometric diagnostics, not tuned policy thresholds or proof of safe preparation.
proof_scope_if_ready: Use forcing Flag threats, branch all rank-compatible first recaptures and test second entry. Uncertain Flag candidates require an explicit conditional conclusion; never label a hidden true Flag as publicly known. An intact own Flag Bomb screen can rule out an immediate two-turn counter-race, but future coordinated threats remain to be checked.
truth_use: Referee replay and offline actual-Flag labels only. Every formation predicate sees public_position masking enemy concealed ranks. No seed or actual setup is passed to a proposed strategy.
comparison: Existing mission has one lead Miner and optionally clears a disclosed recapturer; no paired-entry readiness/forcing overload mechanism found in source.
primary_source: Allis, van den Herik, Huntjens (1993), Go-Moku Solved by New Search Techniques, official AAAI FS93-02-001: https://cdn.aaai.org/Symposia/Fall/1993/FS-93-02/FS93-02-001.pdf
source_relation: Threat sequences restrict defensive replies to urgent responses before a later winning threat. This motivates local bounded forcing analysis, not transfer of Go-Moku's solved-game guarantees.
